text_block_list.text:
One day, while I was struggling to find 
some materials in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'd like to discuss our 
upcoming interview...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, excuse me. It looks like you were 
searching for something.

I explained that I was looking for 
reference materials on Umamusume that 
might help <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Judging by your expression, however... is 
the search for documents not going well?
choice_data_list: I'm having a hard time finding it...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see, understood. Before our meeting, 
would you mind keeping me company for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting. It ended up being 
quite a lot, but please take it.

What she dumped into my hands was a 
massive stack of documents.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I selected a few past articles and brought 
them from the office.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"This information is about an Umamusume 
from quite a long time ago, but I believe 
these materials will be of good 
reference."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And here is the next one. She mainly made 
a name for herself in regional races, so 
she might not be very familiar, but...
choice_data_list:
You really are quite knowledgeable, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course. One must never slack off on 
gathering intel on any Umamusume, past or 
present, near or far.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A reporter's mission is to help shine a 
light on every Umamusume with shining 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"To achieve that, simply chasing after the 
Umamusume who are currently in the 
spotlight won't be enough."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Y-You wish to follow their example!? My 
word... what an admirable mindset...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Those who command information command the 
race. Gathering intelligence is crucial in 
any competition.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To think you weren't satisfied with 
merely reading past documents, but are 
prepared to travel the world to see every 
single Umamusume with your own eyes...

I didn't ask for that much, but every 
single document I received was extremely 
useful.

Training alongside <chrname> based on the materials 
helped contribute to her growth.
